mapper.sql: id, topic_tag, payload, retry_count, last_error, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dlq_record (topic_tag, payload, retry_count, last_error, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{topicTag}, #{payload}, #{retryCount}, #{lastError}, #{status}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: UPDATE dlq_record SET retry_count = retry_count + 1, last_error = #{lastError}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
